title: Ghezelbash 2024: trunk EMG (%MVC) vs forward flexion holding 10 kg at four load heights (19 subjects)
condition: static forward flexion with 10 kg hand load at upright, mid-femur, knee and mid-tibia heights

quantity.name: normalised EMG
quantity.definition: surface EMG normalised to the maximum over six MVE directions in the semi-seated triaxial dynamometer (Ghezelbash 2018); left and right averaged; mean +/- SD of 19 subjects

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Eskandari AH, Shirazi-Adl A, Lariviere C
source.sample: 19 healthy adults (9 F, 10 M), same cohort as Ghezelbash 2020

protocol.summary: Standing, knees straight; 10 kg held in both hands with arms hanging at four heights (upright, mid-femur, knee, mid-tibia); trunk flexion 18.3/50.5/68.1/92.1 deg (Fig 3c x-axis).
how_to_simulate: Scale to the mean subject (169.3 cm, 66.9 kg) or each sex
Static trunk flexion at data[].flexion_deg, knees straight
10 kg in both hands, arms hanging
Output: activation under each electrode, normalised to the model's maximal activity over six maximal exertions

subject_model.source: Ghezelbash 2020 J Biomech 102:109550 Methods (same 19 subjects); weighted means of the two sexes

protocol.notes: Fig 3 caption says 10 kg; Methods text says 6 kg (unresolved in the preprint; 10 kg used). Electrodes per Ghezelbash 2018/2020 (LG and IC at T11). Model curves in Fig 3 are NOT data. Same subjects as Ghezelbash 2020 (14 kg holds).
